days.title: Lakes and Forests of the Ridge
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Abetina Reale
stops.detail: The Abetina Reale forest develops on the right side of the Upper Dolo Valley up to the Apennine ridge on the border with Garfagnana.

stops.name: Lago Santo parmense
stops.detail: Some paths allow you to reach Monte Orsaro, Monte Marmagna and the Parmense Holy Lake, crossing blueberry moors and stopping in the refuges and bivouacs in the area: the Mattei Refuge, the Mariotti Refuge and the Tifoni Hut.

stops.name: Pietra di Bismantova
stops.detail: Further down, on the Emilian slope, the Pietra di Bismantova dominates the landscape with its vertical walls alongside the Secchia river.

stops.name: Logarghena
stops.detail: In spring, daffodils whiten the sunniest meadows of the Park and offer spectacular panoramas especially in the wide meadow expanses of Logarghena, at an altitude of 1,000 m, on Monte Braiola and Monte Marinella above Sassalbo.
